summary.root_cause_text: Config change by ops (queue_max 1000 -> 0, 'worker tuning') made the queue reject every new order, so orders were silently dropped.
recommended: Re-submit or re-enqueue the dropped orders, which were created in the DB but never queued. No available tool can do this, and reprocess_orders only covers processed-but-unpaid orders.
Contact the customers affected, or have the order owners replay them.
Add validation that rejects queue_max <= 0, and alert on any dropped count above 0.

queue_max: 0

queue_max: 0 -> 1000. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).
These dropped orders are actually lost from the in-memory queue, and there's no tool available to requeue them — I'll need to escalate those. The count now stands at 52 dropped orders.
